metadata.title: That 1 kill where I swear enemy hit ‘auto-pilot’ but the game still counted it
metadata.description:
How did that even happen? Enemy must’ve switched to spectator mode.
My aim was on a break but somehow landed a random shot.
Click if your kills sometimes feel like pure accident luck!

Tap if your aim ghosts but your kills still haunt the enemy

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
